title: Rental Rate Bands and Monthly Billing Terms for Durable Medical Equipment Rentals
content:
Rental months of Durable Medical Equipment Rentals items are priced band by band: the position of a rental month within the rental period places it in a band of the class's rental rate ladder, and the band gives the rate paid for that month. The basis the monthly rental allowed amount is figured from differs by payment class.

## Rental rate ladder by payment class

| Payment class | What the monthly rental allowed amount is figured from | Rental-month band and rate paid per rental month |
|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | A percent of the purchase fee-schedule amount | Rental months 1 to 10: 10 percent of the purchase fee-schedule amount |
| Capped Rental Equipment | A percent of the purchase fee-schedule amount | Rental months 1 to 3: 10 percent; rental months 4 to 13: 7.5 percent |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | A percent of the purchase fee-schedule amount | Rental months 1 to 3: 10 percent; rental months 4 to 13: 7.5 percent |
| Power Mobility Device | A percent of the purchase fee-schedule amount | Rental months 1 to 3: 10 percent; rental months 4 to 13: 7.5 percent |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | The monthly oxygen fee schedule | Rental months 1 to 36: the monthly oxygen fee schedule amount |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | The monthly frequent service fee schedule | Every month: the monthly frequent service fee schedule amount |
| Customized Equipment | Not applicable | No rental band applies; the ladder shows not applicable at 0 |

A band left empty for a class means the band is not applicable to that class.

## Monthly billing terms

| Term | Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased | Capped Rental | Continuous Positive Airway Pressure | Power Mobility Device | Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | Frequently Serviced | Customized |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| How a rental month is counted | A 30-day period from the delivery date anniversary | same | same | same | same | same | same |
| Partial rental month prorated | No | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Most rental charges payable for one placement in one rental month | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Patient's cost share on rental months | The plan's durable medical equipment cost share of each paid month or purchase | same | same | same | same | same | same |
| Oxygen contents paid separately from the equipment | No | No | No | No | Yes | No | No |

## Band boundaries, both sides (hypothetical rental months)

| Class | Rental month | Band it falls in | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capped Rental Equipment | Month 3 | Months 1 to 3 | 10 percent |
| Capped Rental Equipment | Month 4 | Months 4 to 13 | 7.5 percent |
| Power Mobility Device | Month 13 | Months 4 to 13 | 7.5 percent |
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | Month 10 | Months 1 to 10 | 10 percent |

## Points of judgement

- **One charge per month.** A placement carries at most 1 rental charge in any one rental month, in every class.
- **No partial months.** No class prorates a partial rental month.
- **Oxygen contents.** Only Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment pays oxygen contents separately from the equipment; no other class has contents paid apart from its equipment.
